message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through my go-bag and realized I might be a tad too prepared. I mean, who really needs three different kinds of snacks for a short car ride? 😅 But as I sorted through my stash, I felt a warm glow knowing that I was ready for whatever little hiccups might come our way. It’s kind of nice to have that peace of mind, even if I do get a few raised eyebrows from family! What’s your go-to item to pack when you’re preparing for the unexpected?
